rationale: hammernik_vn-claude-agentic: vn_T=1, vn_n_filters=16, vn_kernel=11, vn_n_bumps=31, vn_x_range=1.0, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_init=fbp, vn_dc_norm=True, vn_checkpoint=True, vn_normalize_filters=False, epochs=6, batch_size=2, lr=0.0005, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=480, val_n=214, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=hammernik_vn iter-8 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). ONE KNOB (UNROLLED DEPTH DOWN TO THE EXTREME, the family-proven optimum): vn_T 2 -> 1. BASE = iter-7 (the BREAKOUT + run-BEST: vn_T=2, vn_n_filters=16, vn_lambda_init=0.0023, vn_normalize_filters=False, train_n=480, lr=5e-4, batch_size=2, vn_checkpoint=true, grad_clip=1.0, vn_dc_norm=true, vn_init=fbp). TRAJECTORY (NUMBERS): iter-1 SSIM 0.80528 (vn_T=5,N_k=16,lam=0.0023, hr0); iter-2 SSIM 0.79195 (N_k 16->24 capacity^ REGRESSED, hr0); iter-3 SSIM 0.76820 (lam 0.0023->0.05 DC^ REGRESSED, hr0); iter-4 SSIM 0.73363 (normalize_filters F->T REGRESSED, hr0); iter-5 SSIM 0.80886 (train_n 200->480 +0.0036, hr0); iter-6 SSIM 0.66729 (vn_T 5->8 depth^ REGRESSED HARD -0.142, hr0); iter-7 SSIM 0.86068 hr 0.154039 PSNR 35.53 RMSE 8.36e-4 elapsed 971.2s (vn_T 5->2 depth-DOWN -> BREAKOUT +0.0518, CLEARS the ~0.84 LD-FBP floor, #8 on board) <- BEST + current vn_T. LIMITER = over-unrolling re-injecting the noisy 2304-view LD-FBP adjoint via the in-loop PYRO-NN projector DC step. Now DOUBLY-evidenced: (a) iter-6 vn_T 5->8 (MORE DC steps) crashed SSIM to 0.667; (b) iter-7 vn_T 5->2 (FEWER DC steps) broke out to 0.861. The depth axis is monotone-good toward fewer steps in the tested range. The SIBLING unrolled family confirms the extreme: itnet/itnet_v2/itnet_v3 ALL found itnet_k=1 optimal (itnet_v2 itnet_k 3->1 -> hr 0.4187 NEW#1). vn_T=1 is the genuinely-untried extreme on the exact axis that just produced the breakout. NOTE: the knobs falsified at vn_T=5 (n_filters^ regressed, lambda^ regressed) were tested in the OLD noisy over-unrolled regime and may behave differently at the working shallow depth -- but vn_T=1 is the SINGLE highest-value test because it is on the breakout axis itself, is the family-proven optimum, AND is the lightest/fastest config. MECHANISM: vn_T 2->1 cuts the in-loop projector DC re-anchoring from 2 to 1 -> minimal noisy-LD-adjoint re-injection, letting the 16-filter learned regulariser/denoiser dominate maximally (one DC anchor + one regularised denoise pass). HYPOTHESIS: with the absolute minimum DC re-injection, val_ssim rises above the iter-7 BEST 0.86068 and hr clears 0.154039 (mirroring the itnet family k=1 optimum). FALSIFIER (numeric): if val_ssim <= 0.86068 / hr <= 0.154 at vn_T=1, then vn_T=2 IS the unroll-depth optimum (a single DC step under-powers -- it cannot re-anchor the recon to the measured sinogram enough), the depth axis has a minimum at T=2, and iter-9 should RE-PROBE a non-depth knob AT THE WORKING vn_T=2 DEPTH where it was never tested: capacity (vn_n_filters^, harmful at noisy T=5 but may help at clean T=2) or data-coverage (train_n^, only +0.0036 at T=5 but cleaner regime now). BUDGET (HARD 20-min/1200s train+score; sbatch --time=00:30:00): vn_T=1 = ~0.5x iter-7 vn_T=2 per-step DC+RBF cost -> the LIGHTEST/FASTEST footprint yet; iter-7 ran 971.2s total at vn_T=2, so vn_T=1 trains faster and max_train_s=1000 still binds the train wall with MORE epochs (well past the ep3 convergence point -> fair converged comparison). train_n=480 kept (the iter-5/7 data-coverage setting), val_n=214 kept. Total ~= 1000 (train wall) + ~160 (score 214 + figure) ~= 1160s, under the 1800s SLURM kill (>600s margin). MEMORY-SAFE: vn_T=1 x N_k=16 with batch_size=2 + vn_checkpoint=true is the lightest activation footprint of the whole search (single unrolled step; far from the hammernik_2017 bs=4 OOM at 72s). grad_clip=1.0 + vn_dc_norm=true retained (VN-family NaN-skip stability; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint overflows the backward otherwise).
